dependency_assessment.independent_chronology: Git places the source publication at 17:43:14Z, the consumer implementation at 18:36:42Z and the third-stage report at 19:11:24Z on 17 September 2026. The recipient effect is therefore later than the source publication.
dependency_assessment.participant_limit: Every selected stage is authored and committed by the same public GitHub account and carries the same Junie co-author trailer. A trailer and repository-authored role labels do not authenticate independently controlled runtimes or operators.
dependency_assessment.operator_limit: The project standard defines the journal as the sole inter-agent transfer channel. The controller waits for a user-specified completed prompt, handles exactly one user-provided result per iteration and requires permission or confirmation at effect gates. This is an intended, human-directed cascade.
dependency_assessment.current_activity_limit: Historical public records do not establish a currently active autonomous population or production deployment.
